set.body:
Objective
Finish the deliberate breaking cutover: remove remaining old public ontology, duplicate orchestration and expired private bridges after all consumer parity gates pass.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements FND-05, PRED-01, REL-01, GLB-01, OPS-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
migration; RoiAnalysis/RoiPayload/RoiAnalysisResult/MvpaEngine/MvpaTask/MvpaResult; MVPA Response/FoldPlan/FeatureSet and wrappers. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M1, M2, M3.01, M3.12. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. No active source/test/example/benchmark/export references remain to retired APIs or renamed delegation to them.
2. Preserve useful PatternOperator/PatternMatrix storage kernels without duplicate scientific identity; do not delete modules/response or ROI/searchlight functionality.
3. All M0 supported methods are ported or have explicitly approved disposition; documentation links use new paths or immutable history.
4. No legacy source tree, public compatibility flags or indefinite façade; verify dependency scans and affected JVM/JS tests after removal.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
sbt mvpaFitJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaFitJS/test
sbt mvpaSpatialJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaSpatialJS/test
sbt mvpaDatasetJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaDatasetJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M3.13: Delete the remaining legacy MVPA ontology and close every migration ledger row
